browser: local Chromium headless, light theme, no external requests, one client and one outstanding edit
edit_rule: First available adjustable native slider on each preset. Use End unless already at the maximum, then Home. After the first completed edit, alternate keys using the last successful edit.
browser_metric: Trusted keydown to first animation-frame observation of changed settings URL, same machine/unit/time, idle script and rendered numeric risk and server timing.
server_metric: Rounded dashboard caption for the simulate_risk call on the rerun. Excludes page setup and the rest of the rerun.
summary: Nearest-rank p50, p95 and max per preset and viewport. Retain every attempted trial. A timeout, error, changed endpoint identity or missing observation invalidates the run. No outlier removal, pooling or confidence interval.
